B5.title: Flagship that wants everything (intentionally conflicting)
assumptions: Relaxed cost_ceiling_cny: 9 -> 16 (cheapest feasible housing costs CNY 12.59 > target CNY 9)
Relaxed max_height_mm: 18 -> 26 (PCB+battery stack needs >= 25.0 mm overall height at 1.5 mm walls)
Kept (designer refused relaxation) max_mass_g: 120 -> 120 (lightest feasible product weighs 120.5 g > 120 g)
Q2 answered by designer: Manufacturability first; drop the paint, keep IP67
infeasible_reasons: designer kept max_mass_g at 120, but lightest feasible product weighs 120.5 g > 120 g

intent.summary: Flagship model: premium soft-touch painted finish, fully waterproof to IP67, ultra-slim 18 mm thick profile, 100% recycled plastic, weighing under 120 g, and it must cost no more than CNY 9 per housing. Launch in six weeks.
must_haves: cost no more than CNY 9 per housing

conflicts.description: Target CNY 9/unit is unrealistic with premium finish or sealing
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Raise the target to the CNY 18 ceiling or drop sealing/paint

conflicts.description: Sealed gasket housing at this slimness leaves no room for the gasket land
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Relax thickness to the minimum feasible stack height

conflicts.description: Paint / soft-touch coatings contaminate the recycling stream
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Use moulded-in colour with texture instead of coatings

open_questions.question: Which requirement wins when they conflict?
open_questions.default_assumption: Manufacturability and budget win; aesthetics adapts
